== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Wars Not Make One Great (V) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-L-warsnotmakeonegreat-pre.gif]]) and the Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-135-Wars_Not_Make_One_Great.png]]) show the original text.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013), Light Side. Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table. During battles where your Jedi is present, players may not draw more than two battle destiny. Once during your turn, may ▲ Inner Strength. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1220_136</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
